features: 【COMPATIBILITY】- This case is designed for Kobo Libra 7 inch Release Only. NOT fit other tablet models. Please click on "Settings" >>"About Tablet" to check your tablet's model number before purchase!
Magnetic Detachable Design: Features powerful magnets allowing the front cover to detach easily from the clear back case. Enjoy comfortable, lightweight reading using just the minimal clear back case
Soft TPU Construction: Flexible TPU material provides a lightweight and comfortable protective layer around your Kobo without adding unnecessary bulk.
Precise cut-outs for speakers, charging ports, camera and buttons lets you access all the features on your New Tablet
Clear Transparent Back: Transparent back design showcases the original look of your Kobo while providing everyday protection.
